name: Daiguuji Kyousuke
source:
The protagonist and P.E teacher of Hanabatake Academy.
Having been discounted from the position of advisor for the School science club during the teacher's assembly by the principal, he vows revenge against the academy and establishes the "Second Science Club". Together with his Assistant Fuuka, begins exacting revenge...Beginning with the Principal who  didn't give him the role of Advisor.
[spoiler] Has a Son in the Sequel [/spoiler]
